gizmo.title: Nzvimbo yekudonhedza pamufananidzo
gizmo.description: Vadzidzi vanoisa mazita panzvimbo dziri pamusoro pemufananidzo, vozotarisa mhinduro yavo.

configure.title: Mamwe mavara
configure.description: Inotsanangura mufananidzo kuvanhu vasingagoni kuuona. Usaburitsa kuti mazita anoenda kupi.

configure.title: Musoro wemufananidzo
configure.description: Musoro mupfupi unooneka wemufananidzo, unoratidzwa pamusoro pawo.

configure.title: Mazita nenzvimbo
configure.description: Chinhu chimwe nechimwe izita rinogona kuiswa nevadzidzi. Ipa zita zita renzvimbo kuti uise nzvimbo yaro pamufananidzo; zita risina zita renzvimbo nderekuwedzera risingaenderani nekupi. Nhamba dzenzvimbo zvikamu muzana zvemufananidzo.

configure.title: Zita remufananidzo
configure.description: Zita remufananidzo risingamanikidzwe rinoratidzwa pasi pemufananidzo.

advanced.title: Kuedza
advanced.description: Kangani mudzidzi anogona kutarisa. 0 zvinoreva kusingaperi.

advanced.title: Sanganisa mazita
advanced.description: Ratidza mazita muhurongwa hwakasiyana pakushanya kwese.

advanced.title: Inopetwa
advanced.description: Ratidza mubvunzo uyu semutsara unovhurika nekuvhara. Kuvhura imwe kunovhara mimwe mibvunzo inopetwa iri padhuze nayo.

advanced.title: Tanga yakapetwa
advanced.description: Kana ichipetwa, tanga semutsara wakavharwa unoratidza mubvunzo nemamiriro awo chete.

advanced.title: Fomati yemamakisi
advanced.description: OER Schema: fomati yemamakisi eongororo iyi (semuenzaniso mapoinzi, tsamba, muzana, kupedza).

advanced.title: Chinangwa chekudzidza
advanced.description: OER Schema: chinangwa chekudzidza chakabatanidzwa neongororo iyi.

developer.title: Zita rekuyedzwa
developer.description: Zita rekuyedzwa rinoshandiswa pakuzivisa xAPI muhurongwa hwekuongorora.

developer.title: Kosi
developer.description: OER Schema: kosi iyo ongororo iyi yakagadzirirwa.
